verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents automatic linting of OpenAPI specs in its design view, showing error type, line number and message (insomnia-docs-17). The Inso CLI can lint specs in CI with `inso lint spec` and fail builds via exit codes (insomnia-docs-49, insomnia-docs-53). The evidence never shows that the lint rules can be configured or customized as style or governance rulesets, which is central to the story. missing for 10: documented configurable/custom rulesets for style and governance, governance-policy enforcement, independent or hands-on corroboration.
